instruction.text: Choose the action that would help someone to reach their goal.

atoms.a: Saving up for an expensive toy
Making sure they hand in their homework on time
atoms.b: Keeping track of their homework in their diary
Making a practice schedule and sticking to it

atoms.a: Have their parents trust them with a big responsibility
atoms.b: Doing all their chores when asked to

instruction.text: Read the situation and choose how you should act.

atoms.a: Your friend is very upset because they did poorly in a test that you did well in.
You have finished having a picnic and now have a lot of rubbish.
It is past the time your parents told you to be home, but your friends want to keep playing.
Your classmate is playing goalie for the first time and lets a goal in.

instruction.text: Read the situation and choose the two most likely perspectives you could have on it.

atoms.a: School is cancelled because it is a snowy day.
b: “I am disgusted because I like the snow.”
++“I am sad because I like learning at school.”

atoms.a: You are having a sleepover at a friend’s house for the first time.
b: ++“I am happy because I like spending time with my friend.”
“I am angry because we are going to have pizza.”
++“I am nervous because I’ve never slept there before.”

atoms.a: Your friend got a brand new pair of shoes.
b: ++“I am jealous because I also want new shoes.”
“I am nervous because I don’t trust their shoes.”
++“I am content because I like seeing my friend be happy.”

atoms.a: Your big school play is next week, and you have the star role.
b: ++“I am proud because I know I have practised a lot for it.”
“I am embarrassed because I have the best role.”
++“I am anxious because I will be performing in front of a crowd.”
